mediaScope: Unedited native WebGL canvas screenshots only. DOM controls and published state readouts only; no official photograph pixels, model object access or hidden runtime.
notes: before mode captures seven neutral views only. final mode requires root-approved frozen source and build before execution.
RGB comparisons inspect native pixels without altering saved PNGs. A 180-degree rotor pose can be visually symmetric; its state and native frame are recorded without inventing an asymmetric marker.
LED appearance is diffuse lower-shell light through the original solid white enclosure; no aperture is asserted.
The canvas-cap case uses a visible front-view canvas point and real mouse down/up; the distinct dual-source case uses the DOM button panel pointer plus inspection hold.
